newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates close lower.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates close lower.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates closed lower on Monday in a liquid market and dealers said they were likely to remain soft on Tuesday.

At the outset offers were made at eight percent while bids were around four percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. However, the spread narrowed and deals were struck in the range of five and six percent.
In the last hour of trading, rates dropped to three percent due to lending pressure, the dealer said.
